# Meca fixtures

Valid and invalid manifest-driven MECA ZIP packages, including unsafe paths and missing content.

Adapted from the MIT-licensed [open-arrow-access v0.1.0 service tests](https://github.com/dentiny/open-arrow-access/tree/v0.1.0/service/tests) and its `meca` fixture data. Local payloads are reduced/synthetic adaptations.
